description:
This is a booklet given to new mothers sometime between 1912 -1922. There is no publication date. l determined the time period based on the fact that a certain Forrest F. Dryden, whose name appears on the back of the booklet, was president of the company during that timespan. 

Please note: this is not intended as advice for new mothers in the present day. Although women at that time were furnished with these reccommendations, their presentation here is meant simply for historical interest.

l have yet to copy out the feeding chart shown in the booklet but will get to it asap.

l love vintage life advice books. Some of the  most helpful suggestions l have come across are supposedly 'outdated' and l have learned both self reliance from DIY methods  and been inspired by timeless wisdom that l just don't see anywhere anymore.
